plan.title: Single-stage RFQ with two named vendors

steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen.
Enable eRFX event creation for the test company.
Allow vendors to be added during event creation.
Set the event type to RFQ and award the entire lot to one vendor.
Apply the RFQ template so the pricing sheet is available.
Add the specified product and requested quantity.
Verify the delivery location was retained.
Add exactly the two named vendors to the event.
Verify Vendor A appears in the creation-screen participant list.
Verify Vendor B appears in the creation-screen participant list.
Verify the event reached a published project page.
Open the published stage's Participants list.
Verify nobody other than the two intended vendors is a participant.
Verify Vendor A is listed and selected for the stage.
Verify Vendor B is listed and selected for the stage.
